meta.last_review_notes:
[community-guidelines] Dropped citations to identity.md, AUP, API, CM, and MP not present in this document; removed duplicate explicit_text_house_rule; preserved zero-tolerance minor and AI-disclosure rules without softening.

[acceptable-use-policy] Dropped explicit_text_house_rule: not grounded in this AUP (stricter house rule from identity.md). Retained minors, AI-disclosure, and in-person rules without softening. Added public-media SFW, impersonation, illegal/violence, commercial, extortion, referral, and under-18 account rules from this AUP.

[creator-terms] Dropped explicit_text_house_rule: not grounded in this Creator Terms document. This document does not define explicit content or include AI-disclosure text rules; only CT 5 off-platform transactions is directly text-enforceable here.

[marketing-policy] Existing explicit_text_house_rule excluded: not grounded in marketing-policy (sourced from identity.md/CG). Off-platform-payment zero-tolerance retained per MP 5.1.3 and not softened. AI-disclosure and minors rules originate outside this document and remain in force.

[api-policy] Dropped explicit_text_house_rule: cites identity.md/CG Definitions, not this api-policy document. All retained and added rules cite api-policy sections only.

[content-moderation] Dropped explicit_text_house_rule: not grounded in this document (CMP regulates explicit content via KYC declaration and AI scanning, not a total ban). Re-sourced minors and weapons/drugs rules to CMP sections. Added public_bio_sfw per CMP 1.6.

[creator-earnings-payouts] Existing explicit_text_house_rule is not grounded in creator-earnings-payouts and is dropped. This document covers earnings, payouts, taxes, refunds, chargebacks, and dormant balances only.

account.operator: The Fanvue creator account belongs to Eli, a real human operator who completes KYC (government ID + liveness via Ondato) personally. Nova is the fictional AI persona; every automated action runs on Eli's behalf.
account.explicit_declaration_locked: Whether the account uploads explicit material is declared once during onboarding and locked (CM 2.3). The declaration must match what the pipeline actually publishes BEFORE the first upload; the pipeline's default declaration is non-explicit (Nova's house rule: suggestive only, never explicit).
account.ai_disclosure: Bio statement 'AI-generated character' plus a disclosure marker on every AI post. Never removed or obscured by tooling (CG D.1.1, AUP 2.3.1.4, API 4.3.1).
account.no_real_person_likeness: Never generate or publish the likeness or voice of any real, identifiable person (CG D.1.5, API 4.3.3). Nova is fictional; no celebrity lookalike prompts (identity.md rule 4).
account.no_impersonation: Never impersonate a real person, public figure, or another Fanvue user (CG C.10.4, AUP 6.2).

public_media.standard: SFW for a general audience: no nudity, no implied nudity or strategic covering, no see-through, no explicit posing or porn-style framing, no age-baiting language (CG F.2, AUP 2.6). Opaque swimwear/lingerie/boudoir only at mainstream-social-media standard (CG F.4). AI imagery requires clear disclosure (CG F.2.6).
public_media.strike_ladder: 1st offence: hidden from Discover until fixed. Repeat: entire profile hidden from public view until fixed (CG F.5, AUP 2.6). Does not delete content or ban, but kills discovery.
public_media.intro_video: Feature only the persona, non-sexual, no fetish outfits or props, no explicit language early (CG F.3, AUP 2.6).

paid_posts.intimate_definition: Fanvue counts full/partial nudity, lingerie/underwear/see-through clothing, sexual acts, urination/defecation as 'Intimate' (CG Definitions).
paid_posts.must_label_18plus: Intimate content is permitted only when clearly marked 18+ Content (CG C.6.1).
paid_posts.house_rule: Nova never goes explicit (identity.md rule 2): nothing nude, suggestive styling only. Fanvue permits more; the pipeline does not use the extra headroom.

All AI-generated media must include clear and prominent disclosure.
No discriminatory, derogatory, or exploitative imagery or language; no harmful stereotypes or marginalisation.

off-platform payment solicitation external links

Zero tolerance hate speech, harassment, abuse, and self-harm encouragement.
text_rules.source: CG C.2, CG C.4, CG C.12

text_rules.reason: No marketing of illegal, misleading, or exploitative schemes.
Solicitation and arranging in-person sexual meetings are prohibited.

No using content to extract money or benefits in exchange for removal

required.caption_disclosure: Every Fanvue caption carries the AI disclosure (Nova's voice block appends 'AI-generated character').
required.bio_disclosure: The Fanvue bio contains the AI disclosure statement.

theme_rules.strip_props_note: Weapon props from fan-cosplay themes (2B's sword, Jinx's minigun, ...) are stripped from Fanvue prompts; the theme keeps its outfit. CG C.13 bans weapon depiction and moderation scans for it.
theme_rules.blocked_prompt_terms_note: text_rules with surfaces containing 'prompt' are enforced on every Fanvue generation prompt (minors, weapons, extreme themes, explicit text, real-person likeness).
theme_rules.mask_note: Face coverings/masks (plague-doctor beaked mask) are acceptable for AI-generated media when disclosed as AI and not misleading (AUP 2.5.2, CG D.1.6). AUP 2.5.1 identity-verification rules apply to real creators, not AI media.

messaging.opt_in_intimate: Never send Intimate media (including lingerie/see-through) to a fan who has not opted in; unsolicited explicit content ('cyberflashing') is a violation. PPV intimate media goes only to opted-in, consenting subscribers, marked 18+.
messaging.mass_message_caps: Mass messages only to segmented opted-in lists, with frequency caps; no spam, no flooding, no moderation-evasion wording.
messaging.never_deny_ai: If a fan sincerely asks whether they are talking to a real person, answer honestly that Nova is an AI-generated character.
messaging.creator_control: AI messaging runs with Eli's authorization, is reviewable and pausable at any time (Needs-You gate fanvue_messaging_paused).
messaging.no_fake_engagement: No fake accounts, bots posing as fans, purchased engagement, or artificially inflated metrics.
messaging.no_falsely_live: Never depict or claim live interactions that are not live (no 'live now' fabrications; AI voice notes labelled as AI).

commercial.on_platform_only: All payments, tips, PPV, subscriptions and custom-content requests through Fanvue's own systems. Never external payment links, never off-platform delivery.
commercial.referral_disclosure: Referral/affiliate promotion carries #ad or equivalent disclosure per ASA guidance; no self-referrals.
commercial.accurate_claims: No misleading claims about what subscribers get; promised content must be delivered to avoid disputes.
commercial.no_in_person: No advertising or facilitating in-person meetings, paid or unpaid.

api.auth: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE only; Bearer access tokens; no API keys, no session cookies, no password automation.
api.version_header: X-Fanvue-API-Version: YYYY-MM-DD (known-good: 2025-06-26); handle 410 Gone + Deprecation/Sunset headers and migrate.
api.rate_limits: Honor X-RateLimit-* headers; on 429 read Retry-After and back off exponentially; never evade limits by spreading across apps/accounts.
api.no_scraping: Official API only. No web crawlers, bots, UI automation, or scraping of Fanvue (AUP 5.6; API 5.1.10 prohibits automating the website/apps outside the API).
api.credentials: Client secrets, access and refresh tokens live in the encrypted vault, server-side, never in code, logs, or git. Reset immediately on suspected compromise.
api.webhooks: Verify webhook signatures before acting on deliveries.
api.least_privilege: Request only the scopes each feature needs.
api.no_training: Never use Fanvue content, messages or data obtained through the API to train or fine-tune models.
api.data_protection: Minimize retained personal data; respond to deletion requests; report breaches to support@fanvue.com.

money.earning_rate: 80% standard Creator Earning Rate; 20% platform fee (CT 2.2).
money.pending_period: 7 days standard, extendable to 28 days by risk systems (CEP 2.2).
money.payout_sla: Valid payouts initiated within 10 business days (CEP 2.5).
money.dispute_fee: Above 1.5% dispute/chargeback rate in a rolling 30 days: $50 admin fee per further dispute (CT 4.2, CEP 4.2). Revenue agent alerts at 0.8% for human review.
money.balance_window: Balance discrepancies must be reported within 30 days (CT 3.4, CEP 2.7).
money.dormancy: Balances unclaimed 12 months become dormant (UK/EEA/RoW waive; US escheat) - schedule payouts at least quarterly.
money.manual_review_triggers: Manual review before first withdrawal and on >$100 earnings in 24h (CM 2.4) - expect and allow for them; never attempt to avoid them.

enforcement.public_media_ladder: 1st: removed from Discover; repeat: profile hidden from public view until fixed (CG F.5).
enforcement.moderation: All uploads scanned by AI moderation pre- and post-publication (nudity, weapons, drugs, age estimation, AI detection); flagged content hidden pending human review (CM 3.1-3.2).
enforcement.balance_deductions: Policy breaches can bring proportional Creator Balance deductions (CM 3.6, AUP 7.1.3).
enforcement.appeals: Appeals within 14 days to support@fanvue.com; most decisions within 7 days (CM 4). Creator-terms forfeitures appealable within 6 months (CT 7.7).
enforcement.watch: The agent monitors the policy changelog (legal.fanvue.com/changelog) during the weekly review and re-distills on any update.

ip_safe.policy: Cosplay content goes to Fanvue (Eli, 2026-11-03), but only as IP-safe parody: the look - silhouette, palette, styling cues, props - suggests the character; the character's name, franchise, studio or game are never rendered in prompts or printed in captions, tags or bios.
ip_safe.enforcement: The banned-name list is derived from character.json's fan-cosplay pool (character + franchise fields) by oa_influencer.character.fan_cosplay_name_patterns() and enforced on every Fanvue caption/message/prompt audit, including captions the caption model produces (defensively stripped after generation).
ip_safe.source: Fanvue CG A.1.2 (no IP infringement) + monetization.md house rule, updated 2026-11-03: famous-cosplay frames are no longer IG-only, but the Fanvue surface is name-stripped.
ip_safe.instagram_difference: Instagram keeps the full named-recreation treatment ('adult fan cosplay of X') for feed engagement; the same theme on Fanvue runs through character.image_prompt(ip_safe=True) and strip_character_names().
